description: Welcome to Coastal Views, a cozy oceanfront haven offering breathtaking vistas of the pool and beach. We’re pleased to share that the pool area renovations were completed in March 2026, and the pool has been open for guests to enjoy since then.Coastal Views is conveniently located just minutes away from everything to restaurants, bars, grocery stores, shops and the town plaza.The spaceNestled in Rincon, our charming two-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment perfectly blends comfort and coastal charm. The first bedroom boasts a queen-size bed, while the second bedroom features two twin-size beds. A pack and play is available in the first bedroom closet for our little guests. Both bedrooms are equipped with A/C mini-split units, ensuring a pleasant stay.Situated right on Córcega Beach, this condominium is an ideal retreat for families or couples seeking a beach getaway. The living room invites relaxation with a TV equipped with a Roku streaming device, a dining area, and a private balcony to savor the ocean breeze. Remote control light ceiling fans grace the living and dining rooms, complemented by a portable fan for added comfort.The fully-equipped kitchen caters to your culinary needs, featuring a microwave, oven, toaster, coffee maker, refrigerator, electric cooktop, pots, pans, and all necessary kitchen utensils. We've got you covered with paper towels and dish soap. A washer and dryer are also at your disposal, with a gentle reminder to clean the lint filter after each use (please note that laundry detergent and fabric softener are not provided).Guest accessYour access extends to everything within the apartment (with the exception of the owner's locked closet). Guests also have full access to the condominium pool, which is fully operational and available for use during your stay, as well as the sun-kissed Córcega Beach. A designated parking spot is available for your convenience.Other things to noteWe've taken care of the details to enhance your stay. Expect fresh linens, bath and beach towels, an ironing board, an iron, a hair dryer, and a flat iron at your disposal. Essential bathroom amenities such as toilet paper, body wash, shampoo, and conditioner are also provided.Beach gear is not included with the rental. From time to time, previous guests may leave behind items such as chairs, umbrellas, or coolers for others to enjoy. Availability varies, and we’re unable to guarantee, replace, or restock these items.This condominium is home to individually owned apartments, and I personally own and manage this unit. The building’s shared amenities, including the pool and common areas, are maintained and operated by the Homeowners Association (HOA). While amenities are typically available year-round, occasional temporary closures may occur due to maintenance, weather, safety concerns, or HOA policies. These situations are uncommon and outside of my direct control, but I will always keep guests informed of any known updates that may affect their stay.For added security, surveillance cameras are strategically placed in the building’s common areas, along with a personal security camera facing the outside of our apartment’s front door.Please be aware that power outages can occasionally occur throughout Puerto Rico. Neither the building nor our condo is equipped with a backup generator. We understand how inconvenient outages can be; however, power restoration is handled by the local utility provider and is outside of our control. For this reason, refunds cannot be issued for island-wide outages.Conveniently located, we're just 40 minutes from Rafael Hernandez International Airport (BQN) in Aguadilla, PR, and 2.5 hours from San Juan Airport (SJU) in Carolina, PR. While you're here, we recommend renting a car for short drives around the town. Your coastal retreat awaits!

description: Three Little Birds is a newly built 4 bedroom/ 3.5 bathroom modern home w/ all the amenities & stunning ocean views. Designed w/ vibrant colors & curated art pieces, 3LB is sure to spark joy in any guest. Located in Puntas, it's a short walk down the hill to Sandy Beach, restaurants, bars, coffee and smoothie shops. Enjoy the breathtaking views from the balcony, pool, or just about any room of this property. House has generator & water cistern. Not suitable for children under 12 years old.The spaceThis four-bedroom / 3.5 bathroom is newly built and modern in design. The entry level boasts three bedrooms with two full baths, a living/media room, and a dedicated work space that can double as an indoor yoga space. There is an open concept, fully stocked kitchen/dining area on the 2nd level overlooking the pool and ocean. Also located on the 2nd floor is the primary bedroom with en suite, an additional living room, and a half bath. All the bedrooms and both living rooms have AC units. There are dining options for inside and outside, a BBQ grill, and the house has sliding glass doors to let the Caribbean breeze flow through the house. We have a Generac generator and a 700-gallon water cistern to provide water and power during a utility outage.Guest accessGuests have access to the entire property except the locked owner's closet.Other things to noteWe reserve the right to cancel/limit bookings based on the number of nights during Holiday weeks/weekends (3-7 days). Exceptions to the rule applyWe are located on the western point of the island. We are 30 minutes from the Aguadilla airport (BQN), which has daily flights from JFK, Fort Lauderdale, and Orlando on JetBlue and Newark on United. We are 25 minutes from the Mayaguez airport (MAZ) with 6 flights daily on Cape Air from San Juan. This flight is a great option to cut down on the driving time from San Juan.We are 2.5 hours from the San Juan airport (SJU), which has daily flights on all the major airlines.We are 1.5 hours from Ponce Airport (PSE) Airport with daily flights on Jetblue. Rental Car options: Avis, Hertz, Budget, Enterprise, Target, and Charlie's Rental Cars.We don't have UBER and taxi's aren't readily available around town. They need to be scheduled in advance. Taxi's and Car Services can easily to arranged to and from the airports. Puerto Rico frequently has power and water outages so we hope you keep that in mind when using our utilities. Please do not waste water or power and PLEASE TURN OFF AIR CONDITIONING WHEN YOU ARE NOT IN THE ROOM!About the Owners:Jayna and Joel visited Isabella, Puerto Rico in 1996 when they had just started dating. Joel is an avid surfer, and the waves have brought him here countless times since then. When their first daughter was 6 months old, she took her first plane ride to Rincon; the rest is history. They knew they wanted a place here and made that happen in recent years. After 3 years of building (covid slowed that down), they moved in on New Year’s Day 2021. Though they live in North Carolina, they spend as much time as they can here and plan to spend much more here as the years go by. Jayna says, “This place just makes us feel so good, so happy, so relaxed and so connected to the island. We will never stop coming here.”We welcome you to Three Little Birds. The name represents their three kids, Carmela (16), Nina (13), and Franco (13), and of course, Bob Marley gets all the credit for that! They hope you love their home as much as they do. And while you're here, listen to Bob and “Don’t worry about a thing, ‘cause every little thing is gonna be alright.”
